scalar-element.description: FieldMatrix<Gf2mElement> over Gf2mField::gf256(): the shipped gf2-core dense FieldMatrix product, which holds every GF(2^8) call on the route the library takes without the cached table through the shipped lane switch, which is a batched dot product per output cell for the runtime-context element and the carry-less-product whole-gemm kernel for the compile-time-configured value; conservative-portable build

scalar-wide.description: FieldMatrix<Gf2mWide<1,Gf256x11d>>: the shipped gf2-core dense FieldMatrix product, which holds every GF(2^8) call on the route the library takes without the cached table through the shipped lane switch, which is a batched dot product per output cell for the runtime-context element and the carry-less-product whole-gemm kernel for the compile-time-configured value; conservative-portable build

table-element.description: FieldMatrix<Gf2mElement> over Gf2mField::gf256(): the shipped gf2-core dense FieldMatrix product, which leaves the shipped lane switch clear, so gf256_table_dispatch selects the cached product table and one region multiply-accumulate per left-hand coefficient; conservative-portable build

table-wide.description: FieldMatrix<Gf2mWide<1,Gf256x11d>>: the shipped gf2-core dense FieldMatrix product, which leaves the shipped lane switch clear, so gf256_table_dispatch selects the cached product table and one region multiply-accumulate per left-hand coefficient; conservative-portable build
